featured_projects.title: Agentic AI Automation Systems
featured_projects.description: Master's thesis project implementing two production-style agentic AI automation systems on self-hosted n8n: a Customer Support Chatbot with a hybrid PageIndex Tree + Pinecone-backed RAG knowledge base, confidence scoring, conversational memory, and human-in-the-loop escalation via Telegram, and a Personal Virtual Assistant that manages Gmail and Google Calendar with a plan-then-approve safety gate. Each system ships with its own workflows, datasets, knowledge base, and a full evaluation suite -- 1,000 test cases run per system.
features: Customer Support Chatbot: hybrid PageIndex Tree + Pinecone RAG retrieval with confidence scoring and automatic escalation
Personal Virtual Assistant: LLM-driven email management, calendar scheduling, and task coordination with a plan-then-approve gate
Multi-LLM orchestration across Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT-4o, and Gemini
1,000 test cases per system, run through dedicated n8n test-runner workflows

featured_projects.title: Secure Software System Development Project
featured_projects.description: A PHP web application built to demonstrate secure software development practices: two-factor authentication, email/SMS verification, time-expiring password resets, and credential-breach detection checked against a user's password history.
features: Two-factor authentication and email/SMS verification flows
Time-expiring password reset workflow
Credential-breach detection across user password history
Backend protocols designed to block fraud, replay, and false entries

featured_projects.title: InstaMetrics
featured_projects.description: A full-stack web application for tracking Instagram account statistics, researching hashtags, and sending automated direct messages across Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp. Python/Selenium and Instaloader scripts scrape Instagram data, which a PHP (Flight) REST API and a Next.js/React/MUI frontend surface for analysis and outreach scheduling.
features: Collects Instagram user and hashtag statistics via headless Selenium/Instaloader scripts
REST API (PHP Flight framework) with JWT authentication and DAO-based data access
Sends and schedules outreach messages across Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp
Next.js + MUI dashboard for browsing collected stats

featured_projects.title: Movies Watchlist
featured_projects.description: A microservice movie-tracking application: a Java Spring backend (about 90% test coverage) paired with a React frontend tested in Jest and React Testing Library. Recommends genres and similar titles via the OpenAI API and emails genre-matched suggestions whenever a movie is marked "Watched".
features: Java Spring backend with ~90% test coverage
React frontend tested with Jest and React Testing Library
OpenAI-powered genre prediction and similar-movie recommendations
Automated email notifications for genre-matched suggestions

featured_projects.title: Car Rental Web Application
featured_projects.description: A fully functional, responsive car rental platform with a dual dashboard for admins and customers, built in PHP. Covered by backend unit tests in PHP and a companion Selenium (Page Object Model) automated test suite.
features: Dual dashboard: separate admin and customer views
Full booking and fleet management flow
Backend unit tests written in PHP
Companion Selenium/POM automated UI test suite

featured_projects.title: Real-Time Image Analytics Pipeline
featured_projects.description: A real-time image analytics pipeline: Kafka streams image metadata to an OpenCV worker for object recognition, results land in Elasticsearch for search, and AWS EMR MapReduce runs batch statistics over the recognized objects, visualized in Kibana.
features: Kafka-based streaming pipeline for incoming image metadata
OpenCV object recognition on each incoming image
Searchable results index in Elasticsearch
Batch statistics over recognized objects via AWS EMR MapReduce, visualized in Kibana
